intent: Design tokens: color, space, radius, type, shadow, and motion primitives with semantic roles.
Clickable action control with appearance × mode (plus an optional flat set) and a fixed set of sizes.
Joined row of kit Buttons that share one size and act as one control cluster.
Icon-only kit Button: a square action with an icon and a required accessible name.
A main action joined to a chevron that opens a menu of related actions.
one KPI with label, value, optional delta/trend/hint/badge

Metrics strip of kit Scorecards: two to six figures, and the only metric picker. Up to six sit in one row; more wrap, and four or more go two by two when the strip is narrow. Framed cards or a divided strip; selectable turns it into a radiogroup that picks what a chart shows.
Single-line text entry for forms and filters. Optional start and end slots sit inside the field.
A number the person can type, step, and read in their locale, with optional min and max.
A money amount with a currency symbol, locale formatting, min, max, and step.
One-time code / PIN as separate slots. Paste and autocomplete work. Not a row of Inputs.
A recommended insight or opportunity as a compact card, with tone and optional actions.
Change and progress over ordered samples as a line or area chart.
Text that navigates to another page or place: inline inside a sentence, or standalone on its own line, with an external variant that opens a new tab.
A column of links, one a row with a chevron at the end, like an account's quick links.
A list of records, one row each: primary and optional secondary line, leading avatar or icon, trailing value, badge, actions, or chevron.
Square dot-grid loading indicator for compact waits.
How far along or how full something is, from 0 to 100, as a bar, a ring, or a half ring, with optional red, amber, and green zones.
Multi-line text entry for notes and descriptions. Wrap with Field.
Pick a time of day as hour and minute, in 12-hour or 24-hour form.
Choose one or several options from a list. Field trigger, kit DropdownMenu panel. Not a native select.
Type to filter one value, including a list the parent loads asynchronously.
Choose several values. Selected values stay in the field as removable tags, and typing filters the list.
Animated text for short indeterminate processing copy.
Pick a value or range along a track. One piece. Range is a two-value array, not a RangeSlider cousin.
Spinning circular loader for short indeterminate waits. One piece. Sizes 12, 16, 20. inverse for a primary fill. Distinct from LoadingAnimation dot-grid.
Immediate on/off setting. Pill track, role=switch. Not a Checkbox.
Multi-select or confirmation control. Optional visible label.
Single show/hide panel. The whole header row is the toggle.
Inline colour picker for theming and branding settings: saturation/brightness area, hue track, optional opacity track, hex Input, and optional preset swatches. One piece, no popover.
Searchable command menu for quick actions.
Actions for one target, opened with a right-click or Shift+F10.
An editable table: people click a cell to add or change its content, like rule conditions, line items, or mappings. It validates cells, can total the valid rows, and stacks below 30rem.
Framed dataset with search, filters, column settings, and a caption title.
Form field that opens a month grid to pick one date.
Pick a date range from named presets such as This month or Last 30 days, from two months side by side, or by typing the start and end, then Apply.
Pick a calendar date and a time in one field.
Read-only block of code with a copy button, optional title, language label, tabs, and line numbers. No syntax highlighting.
Thin rule that separates content, horizontal or vertical, with an optional label or action on the line.
A full calendar of events by month, week, day, or list. Browse dates, filter calendars, add / edit / delete events.
Inline cell content for datasets: text, link, avatar, file, payment, badge, trend, avatar group, select, progress, rating, or row actions, with optional checkbox.
Column header for DataTable: label, optional select-all checkbox, optional sort, sm or md.
Small help panel: optional title plus one to three short sentences.
A panel anchored to a trigger. Click opens it. Escape and a click outside close it.
Framed tile with optional header, body, and footer actions.
Paged track of slides with prev/next kit Buttons. One piece.
Arrows at both ends of a row or column that is too long to fit, so people can move it along without a scrollbar.
Small number badge for counts, like unread items on a nav link or tab.
How a value moved: an arrow and the signed change in success, danger or neutral text, with no fill.
Assistant panel with a header, a thread, and a composer. Answers can carry figures, a table, a chart, sources and follow-ups. One piece.
Choose exactly one option from a small visible set. Custom circle, not a native radio. One piece.
Two panels split by a separator you can drag or resize from the keyboard.
One labeled control with optional hint and an error or success message. Label on top or start (left).

Choose files Button in a dashed drop zone (or a compact Button-only row) plus a list of file rows with progress, done, and error states. Presentational: the app does the upload; FileUpload reports picked files and renders the state it is given.
Semantic group of fields with a legend and optional description. This is the form group.

A save bar that sticks to the bottom of main on a form page. It says what is unsaved ("2 unsaved changes" and the field names), when it was last saved, or what stopped the save, and holds Discard and Save changes. Save is the page's one solid primary.
Filter chip for lists and tables: shows the filter name or its chosen value, opens its options, and turns an applied filter on or off.
A row of filter chips with add, clear all, and an overflow menu when the row is too long.
Label the user applies or manages: removable, selectable, with optional count, status dot, or avatar.
Tags the person types. Enter or a delimiter adds one. Optional suggestions and an optional maximum with a visible count.
Compact read-only status or category pill set by the system.
Compare magnitudes across categories with vertical or horizontal bars.

A ranked list: each row shows a label and its value, with a quiet horizontal bar behind the label sized against the largest value or the total. Rows can add an icon, a meta line and the change from last period. Top rows first, with Show all for the rest.
Bars and a line on one chart over the same categories, like revenue as bars with growth rate as a line. One shared value axis, or a second axis on the right for the line.
A grid of cells, rows by columns, like weekday by hour, where each cell's shade shows its value. One hue from light to dark, a low-to-high legend, a tooltip per cell and a table view.
Path to the current page as a hierarchy of links.
Brief supplementary text on hover or focus of a trigger element.
Switch between related views in place. Line by default, or segmented, in lg, md, and sm. Tabs can carry an icon and a count, and scroll or fold into a More menu when they don't fit.
Dismissible overlay for short tasks, forms, or extra detail. Composes ModalCard. Not a must-choose confirm.

The panel chrome for a modal: one shared header (tone icon + eyebrow, Close, h2 title, description) and footer (footerStart left, actions right). Modal, AlertDialog and the AppShell work panel render it; Drawer uses the same header and footer. Not a page Card.
Edge panel for secondary tasks. Floating sheet inset from the opening edge.
Actions or value menu from a button, field, or nav trigger.
Placeholder when a list, page, or region has nothing to show. One piece.
What a list, card, chart or page shows when its data failed to load: an icon, what failed, a reference and Try again.
Horizontal site nav. Dropdowns are kit DropdownMenu. Not SideNav. Not AppNav.
Rolling number treatment for live metrics and counters.
Top-of-page title with optional Breadcrumb trail, subtitle, actions, and page Tabs.
Page navigation with previous, next, page numbers, and ellipsis. Not ButtonGroup. Not Tabs.
Part-to-whole share for a handful of segments, as a donut or solid pie.
One dot per item, placed by two numeric measures, like accounts by monthly revenue and support tickets. Optional groups by colour and dot size by a third value.

Task completion as a bar or circle from 0 to 100, or an indeterminate bar when the percent is not known. One piece. Optional name label. Percent overlay, end, or in the ring hole, in Geist Mono. Square bar ends. Tones brand, success, warning, danger, muted, neutral. Sizes sm, md, lg. Fill grows once on load.

Ordered wizard steps as numbered circles with a connecting line and a status word under each label: Done, Current, Upcoming, Error, or Optional. Completed steps can be buttons. Horizontal switches to a compact Step n of m with a Progress bar in a narrow container. Vertical for side columns. One piece.

Grouped page block with optional heading, description, and actions. Unframed: no fill, radius, border, shadow, or box padding — Card owns the framed surface; layout-content owns page inset. Pass collapsible for a chevron that toggles the body.
Product top chrome: brand mark on the start, centered kit Input search, trailing actions. Not a page title. Not a sidebar.
Vertical sidebar navigation with title, optional grouped catalog, and active item state.
A list of the sections on one long page. It jumps to a section and shows the one the page is at.

Product side nav: brand header, icon items, optional badges, closeable; preset props or compose your own from SideNav.Root/Header/Brand/Toggle/Nav/Section/Item compose parts. Not AppNav. Not an overlay itself: on small screens put it inside kit Drawer (the app-shell example shows one way).

Gray placeholder shapes in the layout of content that is still loading, like lines of text, an avatar, or an image, or a whole table, card, or list layout, so the page keeps its shape until the data arrives.
Simple semantic table for invoices, lists, and text rows, with optional sort, row menu, sticky header and loading, empty and error states. Search and filters belong on DataTable. One piece.
Calm processing indicator for assistants and short system waits.
Vertical sequence of now, next, and later for ordered multi-stage work.
A short note that floats in after an action, like Saved successfully, and goes away on its own after a few seconds, with an optional Undo.
Disclosure list for short related sections: one open at a time, or several with type multiple.
Nested hierarchy people open and close level by level to browse, pick, or check items.
A list of usage limits, one a row: the limit's name, how much is used of it, a bar, and a short note.
Inline status banner that stays on the page.
Must-choose overlay that interrupts until the user cancels or confirms. Composes ModalCard (same header and footer as Modal), with no Close.
Face or initials for a person (circle) or an organisation (square). Not a status chip and not a button.
Overlapping row of kit Avatars with an optional leftover count.
Choose one of a few visible options in a joined track. role=radiogroup, sm or md, icons optional.
Selectable cards for a plan or option picker. Single or multi select, with title, description, and a price or meta slot.
A shortcut chip for one keyboard key. Place several in a row for a chord.
The agent asks before it acts: risk, what will happen in words, an exact preview of the command or diff, and Approve (⌘/Ctrl+Enter) / Deny (Escape) with an optional auto-deny countdown.

The guesses an agent made without asking, each with confidence, source and the steps that depend on it, so a person can confirm or correct them before they matter. Compact: open count plus the weakest guess.

A vertical step list for a running agent task: done steps with durations, the current step with a live timer, then pending steps. Becomes an internal part of RunDetail after the next release; prefer RunDetail.
What an agent intends to do, before or during a run. People edit, accept, run, skip, stop, or retry steps.

Deprecated: use AgentOverview. Its All agents list carries status, now, cost and subAgents per agent. Several agents side by side. Each card sums up its sub-agents; one card can open into its sub-agent tree while the others shrink to a compact column.
One agent tool call on one line: status, mono name, summary and a live timer. Opens to arguments and result; with calls it rolls several calls into one group row.
An agent asks for standing access to a capability (files, email, repo, billing), scope by scope, with why and expiry. Grant / Deny, then one line.
Shows exactly what is about to leave the product for a model or outside tool, with sensitive values masked by type and a mask rule per type, before it is sent. Send, then one line.
Many agents, small: a strip of what runs now for a header (row of chips) or a sidebar (stack), with status, activity and a clock.

One agent at work: a live clock and running cost lead; finished steps sit in a time strip you can open. Waiting shows the exact action as an ApprovalCard. Becomes an internal part of RunDetail (its header) after the next release; prefer RunDetail.
An orchestrator and its sub-agents as a tree. Every node shows status, time and cost; branch costs roll up (Σ). Fold branches; approve or retry in place.

Deprecated: use AgentOverview with view="timeline", which renders these lanes on wide screens. Where every agent is right now: one lane per agent over a time window, blocks growing into now, handoffs drawn between lanes, and decisions on the block.

A queue of what agents need from you: approvals, questions, failed runs and finished recaps. Filter, mark read, and select a row to open its detail. Becomes an internal part of AgentOverview (Needs you) after the next release; prefer AgentOverview.

Every time a policy rule stepped in on an agent by itself: blocked, rewritten or flagged, what the agent tried, newest first. A row opens a Drawer with the exact attempt, the rule and its owner, and a confirmed override request.
An agent presents a choice mid-run and waits: options with a recommended one, or a free-text answer. Confirm or skip, then one line.
After an agent says it is finished: each agreed "done when" check marked met, not met, unverified or checking, with its proof. Unverified never counts as met. Accept when all are met, else send back.
How far an agent may go without asking: four readable stops on a kit SegmentedControl, with the current stop explained below.
Redirect, pause or stop an agent while it runs: a steer composer with quick steers, Pause / Resume and Stop with an optional AlertDialog confirm.
Choose which model an agent or chat uses: grouped by vendor, with context window and cost tier, recommended models, and disabled models that keep their reason. Built on kit DropdownMenu.
How full the prompt context is and what uses the space, by segment, with a warning near the limit and Trim oldest. Compact form for a header.
An assistant reply with inline citation marks and a source list. Marks are real links; a missing source shows as a broken cite.
The compact action row on a chat message: copy, retry or edit, thumbs up / down with reasons, and a More menu. Icon Buttons with Tooltips.
Proposed text or code edits you accept or reject in place: unified, split or inline phrase diff, always with + / − marks and the counts in words ("2 added, 2 removed"), then one line.
Facts an agent has stored: search, add, pin, edit or forget them (confirmed in an AlertDialog), and see which ones this thread used.
Where a run's time and money went: a waterfall of model, tool and approval spans with totals and span detail; compact form for a header.
Plan usage or AI credits against a limit: total, usage by category, a daily line with the cap, and a warning near the limit. Composes kit Meter, UsageList, LineChart and Alert.

A first-run checklist with overall progress, each task's status as an icon and a word (Done, Current, To do, Blocked, Skipped) and at most one action per task. The current task's action, or its suggested provider's Connect, is the one solid primary. Built on kit Progress, Badge, Button and Empty, with IntegrationPicker's compact tile. Not a wizard stepper and not a bare Progress bar.

The durable in-app inbox of product notifications: an sm bell with the unread count opens a 24rem kit Popover (a full-height Drawer below --grid-breakpoint-sm) with the list, Mark all read and View all. Toasts stay for instant feedback; agent approvals live in AgentInbox.

A compact "what moved" card for a period: each metric shows before → after and a delta. Good and bad are set per metric (churn down is good), and direction and sentiment are always spelled out. An optional summary sentence leads, rows can be grouped into Better and Worse, and each row can carry a one-line why.

A compact A/B or A/B/n experiment: status in words, the metric and traffic split under each variant's value ("paid within 7 days · 50%"), a confidence note in plain words and one decision (Ship winner, Stop, Extend, Start). Ship and Stop confirm with a kit AlertDialog.

One conversation on a document, invoice or task: comments, one level of replies, @mentions shown as brand text, in-place edit and delete for your own comments (in a More menu), and a composer. Not the assistant Chat. Built on kit Avatar, Textarea, Button, DropdownMenu, Kbd and AlertDialog.

A side panel hosting the comment threads for a page: an Open / Resolved / All filter, thread previews, and the selected thread (pass a kit CommentThread as children) with Resolve. Built on kit Drawer and SegmentedControl; inline renders it in place, and inline="auto" docks it beside the page from --grid-breakpoint-lg.

A filterable catalogue of integrations: search, a category filter with an optional Connected segment, and one tile per provider that ends in a status word (Not connected, Connected, Connecting…, Coming soon) and at most one action (Connect or Manage). connectFlow "detail" opens a Drawer with what it can access and Connect or Disconnect. Built on kit Input, SegmentedControl, Button, Badge, Drawer and Empty.

An in-product plan comparison for upgrades, not a marketing page: a Monthly / Yearly switch, one card per plan with price, features and one CTA. Only the recommended plan is highlighted; Recommended and Current plan are words. Below 30rem the cards become a kit TileGroup with one button. Built on kit SegmentedControl, Badge, Button, NumberTransition and TileGroup.

A document view for an invoice or a credit note, not a PDF engine: header with status and actions, bill-to and dates, line items, totals and one line about payment. A credit note always names the invoice it reduces. Built on kit Table, Badge, Button and Empty.

A Kanban board of columns and task cards, not a full project product. Counts are text. Cards move by drag or by keyboard: Space picks a card up, arrows move it, Space drops and Escape cancels. Built on kit Badge, Avatar, Button and Empty. Becomes an internal part of WorkBoard after the next release; prefer WorkBoard.
The brief a person hands an agent before it plans: a goal, one-line "done when" checks, optional spend, time and step limits, allowed tools, model and check-in level. Start, then one line.
A tiny wrapper that crossfades one child to the next when its key changes, for value and state swaps (a status chip going Running → Done, a thumbnail, a chart). A motion primitive, not a Card.
A short heading that rises in by word or by line, for docs heroes and empty states. The full string is always in the DOM.
A kit Card that tilts a few degrees toward the pointer with a soft highlight, for rare showcase spots (a pricing highlight, a docs gallery). Wraps Card; never the default Card.
A quiet line or dot grid behind a demo or hero, fading out toward the edges. Decorative only; the foreground keeps its full contrast.
A restrained, token-based gradient fill for one rare heading (a docs hero, an empty-state title). Real text, never an image; no motion.

Block: the home for a group of agents. Needs you (the oldest open request as one ApprovalCard, the rest counted), All agents (an icon-and-word status, one fact, cost and one action per row, under one filter) and a Since rail of what happened after the last visit. A Timeline view shows the same agents on one time axis on wide screens. Replaces AgentFleet, AgentLanes and the AgentInbox list.
summary: The agent home: what needs you, every agent's status and one action, and what happened since you last looked.

intent: Block: a social proof wall. A short heading over rows of customer logos that loop sideways on their own, neighbouring rows in opposite directions, fading out at both edges. Each logo is named for screen readers. Hover and keyboard focus hold the motion; under reduced motion the rows stand still and wrap.
summary: A trusted-by wall: rows of named customer logos drifting in opposite directions, with soft edges.

intent: Block: a whole pricing section. A heading and lead, PricingPlans (its Monthly / Yearly switch drives every price) and an FAQ Accordion. The recommended plan's CTA is the one solid primary.
summary: A pricing section: plans with a monthly / yearly switch and the questions people ask before they buy.

intent: Deprecated: use RunDetail with messages and onSend for the Ask panel, and AgentOverview for who is working and what needs you. Block: a live session with running agents. The conversation (Chat) beside who is working (RunningNow), the oldest open approval (ApprovalCard) and steering for one agent (AgentSteering).
summary: Work alongside agents while they run: talk, see who is working, steer one, and approve what they ask.

intent: Block: one agent run in detail. AgentMonitor as the header (live clock, cost, step strip, pending approval) and the selected step's ToolCallCard, beside AgentTree (who started whom), AgentTrail (the step log on the shared rail, status icon plus word) and an Ask panel (kit Chat) to ask or steer the agent. One selected step drives the monitor, tree, trail and tool call. Replaces LiveSession.
summary: One agent run on one screen: clock and cost, every step, who started whom, the selected step's tool call, and Ask.

intent: Deprecated: use IntegrationPicker with connectFlow="detail" and showConnected. AppDirectory now renders exactly that and will be removed in a later release. Block: an app directory with a Connected filter over the catalogue; a tile's Connect or Manage opens a Drawer with the app's detail, what it can access, and Connect or Disconnect.
summary: Browse, search and connect the apps your workspace works with.

intent: Block: a task board with detail. TaskBoard columns (drag or keyboard moves); a card opens a Drawer with the task, Status and Assignee Fields (Select, Avatar) and its CommentThread.
summary: Move tasks across a board, then open one to set its status, assignee and talk it through.

intent: Block: the top of a dashboard. A selectable Scoreboard of three to six KPIs that is also the only picker, a LineChart of the picked KPI, a DataTable of the top rows behind it, and one range control (SegmentedControl) that changes all of them. It composes; it does not re-pick.
summary: Pick a KPI to chart it and list its top rows, with one range for all.

intent: Block: plan usage and what it costs. The main allowance (UsageMeter) beside the plan card with Upgrade and Manage payment, then the next invoice as an estimate (InvoiceDocument) beside the other limits (UsageList), then recent invoices (ListView, a Download action per row). Upgrade is the solid primary only once the allowance reaches its warnAt.
summary: The main allowance, other limits, recent invoices and the plan with Upgrade.

intent: Block: what happened across a workspace. Events from people and agents, newest first and grouped by day (Today, Yesterday, then dates), each with an Avatar, a verb line, its object, a time and Badges; Type and Person filters; Open and Reply on each event; Load more at the end. A history variant shows one record's events (an invoice, say) on the shared rail with a time column and a status word.
summary: See what people and agents did across the workspace, by day, filtered by type or person.

intent: Block: the go / no-go on an agent's plan. The steps (AgentPlan, editable while pending), what the plan expects to change (ChangeSummary), how far the agent may go without asking (AutonomyDial), and one decision: Approve plan, Request changes with a note, or Reject.
summary: Approve an agent's plan before it runs: its steps, what it changes, and how much it may do alone.

intent: Block: review an agent's change set. ChangeSummary on top; the changed files (ListView with +/− counts and a reviewed state) beside the selected file's InlineDiff, a Reviewed checkbox, Accept / Reject file and the file's comments (CommentThread, on the file or one changed line). Accept all, under everything beside the keys line, is the one solid primary.
summary: Review what an agent changed: file by file, with the diff, comments, and accept or reject.

intent: Block: offline regression testing of a candidate agent version against the baseline on a fixed set of cases. A Scoreboard of pass rate, average cost per case and p50 latency, each delta in words (Better / Worse via Scorecard goodWhen); a SegmentedControl with counts (Regressions n / Improvements n / All n) and FilterBar (tag, dataset) over a DataTable of cases (Case, baseline, candidate, Score change, Cost change, Review); a case opens a Drawer with the input, both outputs as a split InlineDiff and the grader's note. Promote candidate is the one solid primary, disabled while regressions are unreviewed, with the reason in the footer bar beside it.
summary: Test a candidate agent version against the baseline on fixed cases before it ships: pass rate, cost and latency, regressions first.

intent: Block: failed agent runs grouped by likely cause. A FilterBar (time, agent, status) over a listbox of clusters, largest first, each with its cause, count, status Badge (New / Known / Fixed / Regressed) and the trend as counts in muted text ("4 more than the previous period"); beside it the selected cluster: status, count, affected agents as text, first and last seen, the cause in a sentence (sample.summary), a LineChart over time, a sample failing call in a ToolCallCard opened to its error and a Table of recent runs. Mute, Mark known and Open issue close the detail, after the evidence; Open issue is the one solid primary.
summary: Failed runs across all agents grouped by likely cause, so ops fixes causes, not single runs.

intent: A billing home for a subscription business inside the app-shell example (inset): a title with Export and one solid New invoice, and two Tabs. Overview: four selectable KPIs (MRR, Collected, Overdue, Failed payments) that pick the revenue chart's metric, the revenue LineChart with a labelled reference line and a title that states the finding, a Needs attention rail, and the oldest overdue invoices. Revenue: the period / granularity / compare controls, a dismissible one-sentence summary, MRR movements, revenue by plan, retention by signup month and top plans. Every Overview card has a labelled Ask in its footer that opens the work panel's Ask tab (kit Chat with a context chip); the panel's other tab is What changed.

Settings form example: a PageHeader over grouped fields (FieldSets in one Card, legend left when wide), a sticky SaveBar that names unsaved changes, an error summary Alert, and an AlertDialog before changes are lost. The demo is company billing details.
List-detail page: in-page AppNav, table list, and detail Section.

First run of a billing workspace inside the app-shell example (inset): PageHeader Invoices with no action, and one Card at layout-container-sm holding Empty (first-use, lg) with Create invoice (the one solid primary) and Try sample data (outline), then one setup line under a Divider: a count, what's left and Open setup (ghost) to the page with SetupGuide. Create invoice opens a Modal (md) that adds a new customer inline (Combobox allowCustomValue), with Plan (Select) and Due date (DatePicker); Create draft hands the draft to onCreate and shows a Toast. Try sample data swaps Empty for an info Alert (Sample data, Clear sample data) over the invoices Table, and Create invoice moves to PageHeader.

One layout option, as a copy-in example: AppHeader over SideNav + content when wide (>= --grid-breakpoint-md, 64rem; layout-shell / layout-app, radius none, no gap), in an inset (default) or flat look. The wide rail collapses to icons (labels in tooltips, remembered for the browser session); a props nav can carry a workspace switcher (or a brand with a subtitle), a quick actions field that opens the kit command menu (⌘K), Notifications as its first row with a panel at the sidebar's edge, a Projects group and an account menu at the bottom; an optional right work panel holds Tabs. Narrow, the SideNav moves into a left Drawer opened by a Menu Button at the start of AppHeader, and the work panel opens in a right Drawer (a bottom sheet below 30rem). header is optional: without it the shell is side nav only when wide (SideNav shows its brand header and toggle) and a minimal top bar (narrowHeader) holds the Menu Button only when narrow. Top bar only, side nav only, or neither are equally fine: compose AppHeader, SideNav, and Drawer yourself.

Sign-in / sign-up page example: centred Card (title is the page h1) with SSO on top, a Divider "or use email", Field-wrapped email and password, one primary submit, and a one-time code step on InputOTP. Presentational: the app passes callbacks and moves the step.

Billing schedule for one customer: the next charge as one figure with its lines, a failure Alert that says what happens next, and Upcoming and Billed as two kit Tables with status as icon and word. Scheduled charges open a kit Drawer to move the date, change the amount or skip the month.

Settings for one connected integration: a Section head (provider, account, Ask) over a Connection Card (status Badge, last sync with numbers, the sync error with Retry inside it) and a Sync settings Card (the form, Save), in layout-container-sm. Disconnect sits in its own Section below, behind a danger AlertDialog.

Settings pages in the Stage look: Profile, Billing, Team, Notifications and Security, each under a Settings › section breadcrumb on the inset panel of a layout-shell--inset app shell whose SideNav lists the sections; with Billing overdue / loading / error, Team empty and invite Drawer, and Security 2FA off.
Guided account setup after sign-in: Business, Plan (TileGroup), Billing, then Review and Confirm. Not sign-in and not empty-first-run.

A ranked AI summary in one card: an icon, eyebrow and time with an X, a title and source, then the findings as an ordered list. Each finding has a rank Count, a title with its change (kit Delta, or a tone-coloured amount), a one-line detail and a Why? toggle that opens a confidence Meter and the evidence. Loading shows Skeleton rows; no findings is a compact all-clear card. Footer: See all and Ask in Chat, outline sm.
